# Build and test dependencies for GitHub Actions on Ubuntu.
#
# Toolchain and debug tools.
make
gcc
gcc-multilib
binutils
nasm
gdb
clang-tidy

# QEMU and raw-disk image generation. fdisk provides sfdisk; mount provides
# losetup, mount and umount.
qemu-system-x86
util-linux
fdisk
mount
dosfstools
e2fsprogs
mtools

# Archive and configure tools used by app builds.
wget
patch
tar
gzip
unzip
bison
byacc
autoconf
automake
libtool
pkg-config

# Test harness.
tmux
socat

# Python environment used by the lit runners and pre-commit.
python3
python3-pip
python3-venv

# Host Python build dependencies.
zlib1g-dev
libffi-dev
libssl-dev
libreadline-dev
libsqlite3-dev
libbz2-dev
liblzma-dev
uuid-dev
libncurses-dev
